blocks.content: To identify both the purchasing and non-purchasing customers in your database, you need to examine all records from the Customers and Orders tables to see which customers have made purchases and which have not.
For this, you can use a FULL JOIN because it combines all entries from both the Customers and Orders tables.

1-- Use FULL JOIN to identify both purchasing
2-- and non-purchasing customers
3
4SELECT Customers.customer_name, Customers.city, Orders.product_name
5FROM Customers
6FULL JOIN Orders 
7ON Customers.customer_id = Orders.customer_id;
